js: const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Start Session'); if(!b) return 'no Start Session'; b.click(); return 'clicked Start Session';
const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Start Logging Workout'); if(!b) return 'no Start Logging'; b.click(); return 'clicked Start Logging Workout';

const checks=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')); return {path: location.pathname, checks: checks.length, unchecked: checks.filter(c=>c.getAttribute('aria-checked')!=='true').length, labels: checks.map(c=>c.getAttribute('aria-label')).slice(0,40), buttons: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b=>(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.innerText).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,30)};
const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>/close|dismiss/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); if(b){b.click(); return 'closed sheet';} return 'no sheet';

const checks=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')); return {path: location.pathname, checks: checks.length, unchecked: checks.filter(c=>c.getAttribute('aria-checked')!=='true').length, labels: checks.map(c=>c.getAttribute('aria-label')).slice(0,40), buttons: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b=>(b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.innerText).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,30)};
